title: Kitty's House
survival_class: Safe . / Secure . / Devoid of harmful entities .
physical_identity: A finite pink-themed home of about 970 sq ft with no outdoor door, tailored to each Wanderer, Baker Miller pink walls and coquette decor.
scale_topology: Finite indoor house: bedroom, master bedroom, two bathrooms, living room, kitchen/dining; windows show artwork.
anomalies: Food replaces itself, decays toward sugar
lighting_sound: Lighting not stated; page carries 'A foggy lullaby' audio; Wi-Fi works; kitchen smells of childhood food.

entities.name: Kitty
entities.behavior: 3.2 m black featureless humanoid; stalks but not hostile; ceases if provoked

entities.name: The Owner
entities.behavior: May appear after certain actions in 974.1

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Kitty (Owner only via 974.1)
hazards: Provoking Kitty removes food and sanity

entrances.method: Carrying a cute item when entering a new level
entrances.quote: there is a slight possibility of being transported to Level 974 instead of the location they would have normally been transported to.

exits.method: Open DreamSleep, then sleep in the bedroom bed
exits.quote: Sleeping on the bed will allow the Wanderer to enter the sub-section, 974.1 .

exits.method: Give Kitty a cute item obtained before the visit
exits.quote: Upon handing the gift to Kitty, you will immediately fall asleep and wake up in a safe level.

signature_mechanic: A tailored pink house where Kitty stalks harmlessly; gift a pre-owned cute item to Kitty to leave; sleep in the bed after DreamSleep to reach 974.1.
conflicts_notes: Email text blank in snapshot. Infobox says Devoid of harmful entities while Kitty stalks; provoking causes sanity loss. Return from 974.1 not stated. 973/975 are nav links.

key_quotes.quote: There appears to be no physical door leading to an outdoor area.
The only furnished rooms are the dining room and bedroom.
The entity has not yet displayed any forms of hostility, opting instead to stalk Wanderers
Your dreams are ready, sleep to start
The only known exit from Level 974 is by giving Kitty a 'cute' item
